ORAL ORDER 7 20-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. C1-181 of 2017 registered under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case.

Further submission is that one matrimonial case filed by the petitioner was disposed of by the Court below with the observation that the complainant/opposite party no. 2 would join the company of the Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.29891 of 2020(7) dt.20-03-2023 matrimonial house but she did not abide the order of the Court below.

In view of the order of the Family Court in divorce case bearing Divorce Case No. 2485 of 2018, the petitioner had deposited a payment of Rs.11,000/- to the opposite party no. 2 to meet the expenses of conveyance.

He also submits that the complainant gave birth to a male child and in a Haresh Kumar @ Haresh Kumar Thakur vs The State Of Bihar on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13337105/
1 birth certificate, the name of the husband has been shown as Ramjee Pandey who is the brother-in-law of the petitioner.
